done_summary: Implemented context isolation per request during async SSR, fixed ErrorBoundary to render fallback only once, and ensured Suspense pops build-data stack on rejected re-renders. Context values are now held in a per-render store carried across await boundaries with AsyncLocalStorage, falling back to default values on runtimes without it. ErrorBoundary now sets a `caught` flag on the first catch to prevent duplicate fallback rendering. Suspense captures and restores the context store at async suspension points.
